test.summary: Feature area - Exporting - Exporting Reports on Goals module

steps.action: Navigate to Goals module of boxName
steps.data: boxName: TC-4252 - Feature area - Exporting - Exporting Reports on Objectives module
steps.result:
Goals module is successfully loaded.

2 PIs are visible. 3 sections are displayed under each PI:

* Main Objectives
* TC-4252 Team A
* TC-4252 Team B

Three goals are displayed under each section in each PI. The exception is PI2 - TC-4252 Team B - no goal in this section.

steps.action: Change Swimlanes view to Reports view
steps.result:
2 PIs are visible. 3 sections are displayed under each PI:

* Main Objectives
* TC-4303 Team A
* TC-4303 Team B

Under each section in each PI there is a pie chart displaying. The exception is PI2 - TC-4303 Team B there is a text displaying: 

No goals to report. Add the first one to display a chart.

steps.action: Click the Export button in the module's header.
steps.result:
Export data window is displayed with following:

# File type dropdown. Export to image (PDF) is set by default
# Blue Export button

Following options shows up in  dropdown:

* Export to image (PDF)
* MS Excel Basic Template (XLSX)
Value in File type dropdown remains set to Export to image (PDF)

The PDF file is downloaded successfully.

Downloaded file name is following the filename schema: goals-<current-date>T<current-time>.PDF

steps.action: Click on File type dropdown again and select fileType.
steps.result: Value in File type dropdown is set to Export to MS Excel Basic Template (XLSX)

The XLSX file is downloaded successfully.

Downloaded file name is folLowing the filename schema: goals-<current-date>T<current-time>.XLSX

Labels: can_be_automated, export, teamsmile

Steps:
1. Navigate to Goals module of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-4252 - Feature area - Exporting - Exporting Reports on Objectives module
   Expected: Goals module is successfully loaded.

2 PIs are visible. 3 sections are displayed under each PI:

* Main Objectives

   Expected: 2 PIs are visible. 3 sections are displayed under each PI:

* Main Objectives
* TC-4303 Team A

* MS Excel Basic Template (XLSX)
